name: Soybean Crush: Oil vs Meal Contribution to Product Value
description: Stacked area chart decomposing the combined soybean product value ($/bushel) into its two components — soy oil value and soy meal value — using the standard CBOT board crush formula: ZL oil (¢/lb × 11 lbs / 100) + ZM meal ($/ton × 44 lbs / 2000). The total stacked height equals the combined product value. A summary table shows each component's current value and its 1-year change (252 trading days). All three futures use NoAdjustment continuation with LiquidityBased rollover.
source:
# Soybean Crush: Oil vs Meal Contribution to Product Value
#
# Methodology (CBOT Board Crush formula):
#   Soy Oil value  ($/bu) = ZL close (¢/lb)  × 11 lbs  / 100
#   Soy Meal value ($/bu) = ZM close ($/ton)  × 44 lbs  / 2000
#   Combined product value = oil_value + meal_value
#   GPM (gross processing margin) = product value − ZS bean price
#
# Stacked area: total height = combined product value.
# Oil (bottom band) + Meal (top band) = full product value stack.
# Summary table: current value + 1-year change (252 trading days) per component.

# ============================================================================
# DATA: Load raw futures and build NoAdjustment continuations
# ============================================================================

# ZS — Soybeans (¢/bu, but we use it as $/bu by treating as-is for GPM context)
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

# ZL — Soy Oil (¢/lb)
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# ZM — Soy Meal ($/short ton)
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

# ============================================================================
# CRUSH FORMULA: Convert to $/bushel
# ============================================================================

# Soy Oil: ZL is quoted in ¢/lb. 1 bushel of beans yields ~11 lbs of oil.
# oil_value ($/bu) = ZL (¢/lb) × 11 / 100
oil_value = zl.c * 11.0 / 100.0

# Soy Meal: ZM is quoted in $/short ton. 1 bushel yields ~44 lbs of meal.
# meal_value ($/bu) = ZM ($/ton) × 44 / 2000
meal_value = zm.c * 44.0 / 2000.0

# Combined product value ($/bu) — total height of the stacked area
product_value = oil_value + meal_value

# ZS is quoted in ¢/bu — convert to $/bu for GPM
bean_price = zs.c / 100.0

# Gross Processing Margin ($/bu)
gpm = product_value - bean_price

# ============================================================================
# 1-YEAR CHANGE (252 trading days)
# ============================================================================

oil_value_1y_ago  = oil_value  >> 252
meal_value_1y_ago = meal_value >> 252

oil_change_1y  = oil_value  - oil_value_1y_ago
meal_change_1y = meal_value - meal_value_1y_ago

# ============================================================================
# CHART: Stacked Area — Oil vs Meal contribution over time
# ============================================================================

idx = index()()

xy_lines(
    title='Which Component Drives Product Value? Oil vs Meal ($/bu)',
    category='Crush Component Breakdown',
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    y_axis_label='Product Value ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Oil Value ($/bu)',  color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soy Meal Value ($/bu)', color=Color.Sky)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(oil_value, meal_value))

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Current value + 1-year change per component
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Component Snapshot (Current vs 1 Year Ago)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Soy Oil ($/bu)', 'Soy Meal ($/bu)'],
        col_headers=['Current Value', '1-Year Change'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_color_map={Color.Success: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Error: ["NEGATIVE"]}),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_color_map={Color.Success: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Error: ["NEGATIVE"]})
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Component Breakdown',
    order=2
)(oil_value, oil_change_1y, meal_value, meal_change_1y)
